comments.author: DBravo
comments.body: I lit a primitive bonfire and this special item effect took place for 1 hour. You have to sit or kneel next to the bonfire. It will expire if you move away or log out.

comments.author: Fawn
comments.body: Will the Boston Cartographer research 2 skill work for sky charting?

comments.author: Beomi
comments.body: Haven't check yet. and have not heard that Cartographer Research 2 also work on Sky Charting. However, some players recommended Astronomer's Wisdom 1 will be better while doing Sky Charting.

comments.author: Fawn
comments.body: Ty Beomi! Now I have a mission to get Astro Wisdom 1!

comments.author: Monarchy
comments.body: yea, use Astronomer's Wisdom 1 is better than Cartographer's Knowledge 1 because most celestial discoveries require a title to find.
